report_label: 조각 배치: 규칙 동등, 배치 동등은 미검증

evidence: 0x6add87-0x6ade3a: nine float literals written to a stack image (decoded by the probe)
TerrainShader pass 0 DS: mul/mad with cb1[11], cb1[10], cb1[12], add cb1[13], dp4 chain
A_bicubic.limit: Upload values and shader arithmetic only; no GPU output compared.

A_bicubic.claim: The basis is the Mitchell-Netravali cubic with B=3/4, C=0. It is not the uniform B-spline, Catmull-Rom or Bezier basis.
evidence: identity of all 16 entries with the B,C formula (probe)
independent kernel comparison in the CPU check
A_bicubic.consequence: Partition of unity and C1 hold; controls are not interpolated (weights 1/8, 6/8, 1/8 at t=0); a linear height ramp is not reproduced exactly.

A_bicubic.claim: Control index word = (py+r+2)<<8 | (px+c+2); the VS decodes ((id&255)-3, (id>>8)-3) control spacings; control 5 is the patch origin; u follows c, v follows r; patches are emitted rows outer, columns inner, for five levels of size (n>>1)+1.
evidence: TerrainShader pass 0 VS and HS instructions

A_bicubic.claim: Control height = alpha * cb1[16].z * 255 with cb1[16] = (1.0, 0.866, 0.2): 51 world units at alpha 1; horizontal world = height texel * (1.0, 0.866).
evidence: no direct store to the three globals in .text (probe scan)
A_bicubic.limit: Indirect writes through a pointer cannot be excluded by a static scan. The same cb1[16].z is used by the non-tessellated passes.
A_bicubic.note_for_codex: This bears on the phase-1 candidates height scale 2.3 and offset 15300/65535: the retail factor is alpha*0.2*255 with 64 height texels per hex.

A_bicubic.claim: Tessellation factor cb1[14].x = float(uint object+0x2428), initialised from config BicubicTerrainTessSubdiv (0xd90f14); the debug step doubles or halves it within 1..16 and the quality function rounds it down to a power of two. Partitioning is integer.
A_bicubic.limit: The value stored in the user configuration file was not read.

A_bicubic.claim: Per-draw cb0: [4] = float of int cell fields +0xdc,+0xe0,+0xe4,+0xe8; [5].xy = 1/(W+1), 1/(H+1); [6].xy = (W-1)/(W_level-1), (H-1)/(H_level-1); [6].z = float object+0x2424 (height mip level), W = cell+0xd4, H = cell+0xd8.
A_bicubic.limit: Layout is confirmed; the concrete W, H and origin integers of a real map are not traced (candidate).

A_bicubic.claim: Tessellated passes are used only when BicubicTerrainTessellation (0xd90f1c) is non-zero and TerrainTessLevel (0xd90f70) is non-zero; the patch index buffer and level update exist only at device tier >= 10.
World translation cb0[0..3] built from object+0x1ab0/0x1ab4/0x1ab8.
A_bicubic.limit: The cb1 writer reads +0x1ab0/+0x1ab4 as integers (fild) while this code treats the same offsets as floats; the two objects or the field types are not reconciled.

items.claim: Camera class methods: 0x8e4920 (one argument, caller 0x4bb9d3), 0x8e4940 writes +0xc (callers 0x4874fe, 0x492deb, 0x4a3c15, 0x4bba0d), 0x8e4960 writes near/far +0xd0/+0xd4 (callers 0x4728d5, 0x487517, 0x74f09f), 0x8e5170 writes the matrix at +0x10 (callers 0x41be66, 0x59877d, 0x6047aa, 0x6047bf), 0x8e4c00 LookAt (callers 0x605f61, 0x74f07c, 0x78460e).
evidence: call-site scan of .text; method bodies not yet pinned
items.limit: Which caller owns the world view is not established.

items.claim: 0x42d790 builds a 90-degree projection and six fixed LookAt directions: a cube capture, not the world camera.
0x74ef80 with 0x4bb6e0 drives a bone-animated camera (field of view from an animation track, default eye (0,-250,50), near/far from object +0x8a4/+0x8a8): not the world camera.
0x487330 passes 45 and 10000 to 0x8e4940/0x8e4960; config "Minimum Zoom Level" has default 11.0 (0x5cf945, text "11.0=default, 4.0=debug zoom").
items.limit: Owner object and whether these reach the world view are not traced.

items.claim: Actual world camera instance, pose, field of view, clip planes, zoom curve.

side_findings_for_codex.note: Read from listings on 2026-11-15; addresses are given for follow-up, no pinned probe yet.
items: cb1[22].xy = (1/1024, -1/1024), cb1[23].xy = 1/512 (0x6ae12a; pinned in the basis probe).
cb1[17] = object+0x400.. (light direction used by the 40-step shadow march), cb1[18] = object+0x40c..; both are set by 0x5996e0, called from 0x457eb5, 0x5bd003, 0x60ff55.
Light angles are initialised at 0x6b8438: 90, 25, 80, 135 degrees and amount 0.5; vectors are (-cos(yaw)sin(pitch), -sin(yaw)sin(pitch), cos(pitch)).
Cell bake function 0x694a60 emits the markers HeightMap, Decal Layer, Normal Calculation, Macro Shadow, Decal Macro Shadow in that order; Terrain Cache and DXT Compress follow at 0x695c34.
Macro Shadow loops TerrainShadowQuality (0xd90f6c) times; each pass gets cb0[75].z = 1/N, used by the PS as start bias and output scale.
Cache target sizes are set per TerrainDetailLevel in 0x453f80 (0xd90f2c scratch 128/256/512, 0xd90f34 cache 128/256).
Water constant block (0x250 bytes) is written near 0x73a7d8: plane height uses object+0xc8 * 0.2 * 255.
